body.mātṛkātantram:
<śāradā>
<śrīraṇavīraparisara jammū>
oṃnamaḥśivāya||oṃnamaḥsarasvatyai||oṃnamogurave||oṃśrīrastu oṃkailāsaśikhareramye nānāratnopaśobhite|| papracchaparayā bhaktyā bhairavaṃpraticaṇḍikā|| oṃśrīcaṇḍikā|| oṃtripurāpū janaṃnāthasvarṇaratnaiḥviśeṣataḥ|| kaliyugesvarṇaratnaṃbhave ddhematathāmaṇiḥ|| kenopāyenadeveśi svarṇaratnādikaṃlabhe t|| jñātoktaṃsarvaśāstreṣutadvadasvadayānidhe|| śrīśaṃkaraḥ|| oṃśṛṇudevipravikṣyāmi yathāratnādikaṃlabhet|| mattejasā pāradena kiṃnaraṃlabhyatenahi|| yathāgūḍhaprakāreṇa śuddhaṃsaṃ vallakenaca|| śaṃbalasyaprakāraṃhi śṛṇudravyaṃpriyaṃvade|| vī ratantrānusāreṇa pūjayetsiddhakālikā|| athavāpūjaye ddevīṃ dakṣiṇāṃkālikāṃparāṃ|| kālītantroktavidhi nā saptāhaṃjapapūjanaiḥ|| satyecaikaṃtutretāyāṃ dvigu ṇaṃdvāparetrayaṃ|| evaṃsarvatrajānīyāccaturguṇaṃpūja yetkalau|| ānīyabahuyatnena śaṃbalaṃtolakodvayaṃ|| va surāyuḥśivaṃcādyaṃ māyābinduvibhūṣitam|| bīja trayaṃcāṣṭaśataṃ prajapeśśambalopari|| aśītitolakaṃ mānaṃ kṛṣṇādhenusamudbhavam|| dugdhamānīyayatnena cāṣṭottaraśa taṃjapet||
oṃśrīḥmaḥ <1 pṛ0 1a> raktavastreṇasūtreṇa dugdhamadhyevinikṣipet|| utthāpyajñārṇa yeddhīmanmandamandenavahninā|| bindudevāgniparyantaṃ a rdhaśeṣayadābhavet|| tadaivatolanadravyaṃ dugdhamadhyevinikṣi pet|| tataḥparīkṣākartavyā pradadyātpāvakopari|| nirdhūma pāvakedravyaṃ draṣṭvāutthāpayettataḥ|| tatraivaprajapenmantraṃ sarvalakṣaṇacātmakaṃ|| sārdhaṃcatokaṃtāmraṃca vahnima dhyevinikṣipet|| yathāvahnistathātāmraṃdraṣṭāutthāpaya ttataḥ|| guṅjāpramāṇataddravyaṃtaccūrṇepadiyojapet|| sa tyaṃsatyaṃhigirije ropyaṃbhavatiniścitam|| oṃśrī caṇḍikā|| oṃkāraṇaṃdugdharūpāvā kenopāyenaśaṃkaraḥ|| tatprakāraṃmahādeva kṛpayāvadaśaṃkara|| oṃśrīśaṃ karaḥ||oṃṭaṅkanaṃcānayeddhīmāttolakaṃcacatuṣṭayaṃ|| vahniyogenagirije lājāraupyaṃcakārayet|| ā mrapuṣpaṃcadviguṇaṃ piṣṭhāmelanamācaret|| tasyo parijapenmantraṃ sarvadālakṣmaṇātmakam|| mahāmā yāṃjapetpaścādaṣṭottarasahasrakam|| tatastaguṭikāṃ kṛtvā melanaṃkārayedyadi|| tadaivadugdharūpaṃsyātsatyaṃsa tyaṃcaśailaje||
yāmāyāmadhukaiṭabhapramathinīyāmāhiṣonmūlinīyādhū mrekṣaṇacaṇḍamuṇḍamathinīyāraktabījāśinīśaktiḥ sumbhanisumbhadaityadalinīyāsiddhalakṣmīḥparāsāde vīnavakoṭimūrtisahitamāṃpātuviśveśvarī|| oṃmantraṃśṛṇuvarārohetrailokyepicadurlabhaṃ oṃeṃ hlīṃklīṃhrīṃklīṃnamaḥvedādhāṃvāgbhavaṃmāyāṃkā mabījaṃtataḥparam sthiramāyāṃmahāmāyāṃkā mabījaṃtatonamaḥ navākṣaraṃmahāmantraṃjapedādau śataṃviparītaṃmahāmantraṃpāṭhentetuśataṃjapet śṛṇudevipravikṣyāmiṛṣiḥchandaḥsulakṣaṇaṃ oṃsaptaśatīmahāstotrasyamedhātithiḥṛṣiḥ gāyatrīanuṣṭupvṛhatīpaṅktistriṣṭujaga tīchandāṃsimahākālīmahālakṣmīmahāsa rasvatyodevatāstavakaṃ eṃhrīṃklīṃbījaṃkṣauṃśaktiḥ mamāmukakāmanāsiddhyarthepāṭheviniyogaḥ|| praṇavenamaheśāniṣaḍaṅgadhyānamācaret i titekathitaṃkāntecaṇḍīpāṭhasyalakṣaṇam
<śrīḥ 10> sāvarṇisūryityādisāvarṇibhavitāmanuḥetanmantraṃ paṭheddevisaṃsthāpyacadinatrayaṃvāratrayaṃpaṭheddeviki ñcitṛṇādikaṃnahi mahārogemahāduḥkherāja pīḍādidāruṇenānāvyādhigatevāpicāyunā śetathābhaye grahapīḍādisaṅghātebrahmahatyādi pātake evaṃpāṭhenadeveśimucyatenātrasaṃśayaḥ bahukiṃkathyatedevisarvaśāntiḥlabhennaraḥsa rvaśaṅkāvinirmuktojāyatemadanopamaḥ evaṃ kṛtemaheśāniyadiśāntinajāyante || punastenaivakartavyaṃ tataḥsiddhobhaveddhruvaṃ itiśrīmātṛkābhedatantreṣaṣṭhaḥpaṭa laḥparipūrṇaḥ||6|| oṃśrīḥ
oṃśrīcaṇḍikā|| oṃgandhahīnaṃbhaveddravyaṃ kenopāyenaśaṃkaraḥ|| tatsarvaṃśrotumicchāmi yadisnohostimāṃprati||śrīśaṃkarovāca|| oṃśivaṃvahnisamārūḍhaṃvāmanetravibhūṣitam||bindunāda samāyuktaṃ gandhamādāyasaṃvadet||ulloṭyapadamuccārya cāṣṭo ttaraśataṃjapet|| tadaivajāyatesatyaṃ durgandhādivināśanam|| [itiśrīmātṛkātantrabhedaprathamaḥpaṭalaḥ]|1| oṃśrīdevī|| oṃvadamīśānasarvajña sarvatatvavidāṃbara|| yatvayākathitaṃ nātha samasargovihārataḥ|| kathaṃvājāyateputraḥ śukrasyakutra vānsthitiḥ|| vaddhamānaṃsadāliṅgaṃ praveśaṃvākathaṃbhavet|| i tiyuktāhyahaṃnātha trāhimāṃduḥkhasaṅkaṭāt|| oṃśaṃkaraḥ||oṃ maṇipūremahāpadmaṃ suṣmaṇāmadhyasaṃsthitā|| tasminnālokadeve śī nābhirandhraṃmanoharam|| aṣṭapatrasamāyuktaṃ sadāmuktavibhūṣitam|| tasyadevaṃstandvaṃndvaṃvardhamānaṃdinedine|| madhyanālaṃsuṣmaṇānta rvṛttākāraṃ suśobhanam(suśītalamityapipāṭhaḥ)|| anāmyagramadhyenālaṃ sadānandamayaśive|| śṛṇucārvāṅgiśubhage tanmadhyeliṅganayat|| yadrūpaṃparamā nandaṃ tatrāstibhuvanatraye|| nābhipadmaṃtuyadrūpaṃ tacchṛṇuṣvasamā hitaḥ|| bindusthānaṃmadhyadeśe sadāpaṃkajarājite|| bāhyade śecāṣṭapatraṃ caturaśraṃcatadbahiḥ|| caturdvārasamāyuktaṃ suvarṇa bhāsvadvṛttakam|| tatpatreṇabhavetpuṣpaṃ binduyuktaṃtripaṃcakam|| (citram)
<śrīḥ 2a> praphullatatrapatrāre bāhyaṃcādhikadarśanam|| tanmadhyetumaheśā niyadisyālliṃgatādiyat|| padmamadhyegataṃsūtraṃ santatiḥ tenajāyate|| puruṣasyavyapaddrarthaṃ(?) śaktervācādhikaṃbhavet|| tadākanyābhaveddevī viparītepumānbhavet|| ubhayostulyayogaṃ taṃkṛī(kṣrī)(?)vobhavatiniścitam|| śṛṇucārvaṅgisubhage puṣpa māhātmamuttamam|| saṃyogamadhyetadyuktaṃ vardhatecadinedine||e vaṃdvimāsesamprāpte tatpuṣpavyatisaṃyutam|| galitaparameśā nivyaktābhavatisantatiḥ|| kiñcidrogādisambhūte kramakī ṭādisambhave|| tasmājjīvaḥpraṇaṣṭaḥsyā tsanārījīva tikathaṃ|| oṃśrīśaṃkaraḥ|| oṃtasyapuṣpasyamahimā kiṃvaktuṃśa kyatemayā|| bindusyānnasahasraṃtu puṣpamadhyepriyaṃvade|| budbu dāyatratiṣṭhanti tantraivasantatirbhavet|| vardhamānemahāpuṣpa pīḍākiñcinnajāyate|| evaṃkrameṇadeveśi sahasraṃsantatirbha vet|| mamasārdhaṃmaheśānivihāraṃkuruyatnataḥ||vihārayo bhavetputro gaṇeśaḥparikīrtitaḥ|| aparaṃparameśānitavaputra prasādataḥ|| pṛthivyāṃjāyatersṛṣṭiḥ nirvighnenayathocitam|| etacchrutvāmahādevi madanānalavihvalā|| śivaṃcālaṅga yeddevīśivopisamatāyayau||[itiśrīmātṛkātantre dvitīyaḥpaṭalaḥparipūrṇaḥ]||2|| oṃnamomātṛkāyai||
oṃ oṃśrīdevī|| oṃsarvatrāpiśrutaṃnāthabhogaṃcandrāyasaukhyadam bhogenamokṣamāpnotikathaṃvadasiyogavit|| oṃśaṃkaraḥ|| bhogenalabhyateyogaṃbhogenakulasādhanam bhogenasiddhimā pnotibhogenamokṣamāpnuyāt tasmādyogapadākāryābāhya pūjāyathoddayā bhojanasyavidhānaṃtucchṛṇuṣvapriyavade mūlādhārātupāśaktibhujaṅgākārarūpiṇī jīvātmā parameśānitanmadhyevartatesadāguṇayuktākuṇḍalinīcandra sūryāgnirūpiṇī mūlādhāracyutāṃdevīmāṃjihvātāṃvibhā vayet śodhitānmatsyamāsādīnmūnmukhensthāpayedbudhaḥ mūlamantrasamuccāryajuhomikuṇḍalinīmukhe anena vidhinādevī sarvaṃvācasamāharet bhunaṃṅktikuṇḍali nīdevīdvaticintāyaparohiyaḥ mantrasiddhirbhavettasya jñānasiddhinavānyathā evaṃkṛtebrahmarūpaḥśivaḥrūpa svayaṃhariḥ yogasiddhirbhavettasyacāṣṭasiddhiṃbhaviṣyati śatrubhirdīyatedhantudāruṇaṃkṛtrimaṃviṣaṃ yasyāścabhakṣa ṇāddevīcāmṛtatvaṃnasaṃśayaḥ mantreṇaśodhayeddravyaṃta tkṣaṇādamṛtaṃbhavet tadaivakālakūṭaṃtusamudraṃmathanaṃ priye tadācāreṇamathanātadviṣaṃkhāditaṃmayā sarpā kāṇḍalinīyādevīparamākalābhujyate sūryarūpeṇa
<śrīḥ 3a> viṣamapyamṛtaṃbhavet ititekathitaṃdevibhojanasyavidhātma kam etatsarvaṃmaheśānigoptavyaṃpaśusaṅkaṭe||śrīdevī|| oṃśṛṇunāthaparānandaparāparakulātmaka vadamevipra mīśānahomakandaṃtukīdṛśaṃ||oṃśrīśaṃkaraḥ|| oṃma ṇipūrasyabāhyaṃtunābhipadmaṃmanoharam aṣṭapatraṃtathā
(citram)
vṛttaṃtanmadhyekuṇḍadurlabhaṃ caturaśrādikaṃdevitatku ṇḍaṃkāmarūpakam sarvakuṇḍasyadeveśiviprakartā vidhīyate vartulaṃbahujātasyavaiśasyavārdhacandrakam trikoṇabhūṣitaṃkuṇḍaṃśūdrāṇāṃparikīrtitam evaṃ kuṇḍamaheśāninātratrayavibhūṣitam ūrdhanālaṃ sahasrāreparāmṛtavibhūṣitam madhyanālaṃnābhide śaṃ mūlādhārīcasundarī āliṃganāmadhyenālaṃsa dānandamayaṃśive homakuṇḍamidaṃdevī sarvatantrapari smṛtam yenahomaprasādenasākṣādbrahmamayaṃbhavet viprasyacāhutiṃhomevijñātavyā catuṣṭayaṃ rājanyasya trayadevīvaiśyasyacāhutidvayaṃ śūddhasyaikāhutirdevī muktiścāpicaturvidhā mahāmokṣobrahmaṇasyasāyu jyaṃkṣatriyasyaca sārūpyabāhuetāsya sālokyaṃpā dajātiṣu bāhyakuṇḍaṃbāhyahomemeṣva (*) vaṃhisurava ndite
janibhedaṃkuṇḍabhedaṃkuryātsādhakasattamaḥ bāhyahomekā masiddhibhaviṣyantinasaṃśayaḥ ititekathitaṃkānteta ntrāṇāṃsāramuttamaṃ navaktavyaṃya(pa)śoragrosapathotatvayipriye śrīdevyuvāca|| madyapānaṃmahāpuṇyaṃsarvatantreśrutaṃmayājā tibhedenakathitaṃdadānītatprakāśaye||śrīśaṃkarovāca sarvayajñādhipoviprasaṃśayonāstipārvatī sautrāmaṇyāṃ mahāyajñocatvārobrāhmaṇādayaḥ brahmaṇasyamahāyogaṃ madyapānepriyaṃvade brāhmaṇāparameśāniyadipānādikaṃ caret tatkṣaṇeśivarūposausatyaṃsatyaṃhiśaileje toyeto yaṃyathālīne tejetejaśiveyathā ghaṭebhagnaṃyathā kāśaṃvāyvevāyaupriyaḥtathaiva madhyamānenabrāhmaśipriye līyatenātrasandehosatyaṃsatyaṃhiśailaje sāyujyapi tathāmokṣoniyuktaḥkṣatriyādiṣu yānārīmadhyapānena sādevīnātrasaṃśayaḥ sūkṣmasūtreyathāvahnidehama dhyeyathāśive taporūpavṛhatsūtraṃpūjārūpaṃyathāhaviḥ harirvākurutedevīvardhamānaṃvidurbudhāḥ madhyamānaṃvi nādevitatvajñānaṃnalabhyate atevahiviprohimadhyamā naṃsadācaret vedamātājayatnaiva(?)brāhmaṇenahiśai laje brahmajñānaṃyadādevi tadābrāhmaṇamucyate
<śrīḥ 4a> vedāmnāyasmṛtaṃbrahmatadīyaṃkaulikesvarā havirāru pyamātreṇavahnidāhoyathābhavet śāpamocanamātreṇa svarājñānapradāyinī atevahideveśi brahmaṇaṃpā namācaret sabrāhmaṇaḥsavijñeyaḥsognihotrī sadīkṣitaḥ bahukiṃkathyatedevisevatriguṇātmakaḥ muktiścayojapeddevigoptavyaḥpaśusaṅkaṭe prakāśā tsiddhihāniḥsyānnindanīyonacānyathā||[itiśrīmā tṛkātantrabhedetṛtīyaḥpaṭalaḥ]||3||oṃśrīdevī oṃkāraṇenamahāmokṣonirvikalpaśivasyaca śrutaṃ vedapurāṇeṣutavavaktrāsureśvaram agrāhyaṃśivani rmālamagrāhyaṃkāraṇaṃprabho mṛpāvodhyamahādeva kathaṃvadatiyogavit(ghṛt)||oṃśrīśivuvāca||oṃśṛṇu devipravikṣyāmisāvadhānāvadhārayaḥ tatesarvaṃpravi kṣyāmiyanmetvaṃparipṛcchasi caturāśītilakṣyeṣusa hasreṣutathaivaca bhrāmaṇaṃkurutejīvaḥtatomokṣasya bhājakaḥ etatmadhyemahājñānaṃyadisyādvīravandi te tadāmokṣamavāpnotibhramaṇaṃkasyavābhavet ata evamaheśāniguptabhāsātmevaca tatadbhāvenatadvākyaṃ
rnamithyāparameśvarinirvāṇaṃviprayeddevimadyaṃ paramakāraṇaṃ madhyapānavinādevimahāmuktirnalabhyate||śrīcaṇḍikā|| oṃgaṃgāyājñānatomokṣatadaivamṛyateyadi gaṃgāyāḥ cādhikaṃnāthakāraṇaṃparadurlabhaṃ||oṃśrīśivuvāca|| pūrṇabrahmamayīdevisurādevīcanānyathā tasmācca ṣoḍaśaṃsaikāyāgaṅgāsurapūjitā tathaivatulasīdevī satīśaikāsureśvarīvimokṣārthīcayomṛtyuṃtīrthasai vaḥsamācaret tathaivamālikāmadhye mahāśaṅkhaṃvimo kṣadaṃ tathaivakāraṇaṃdevisadāmokṣapradāyakam kāraṇenavinādevimokṣajñānādikaṃnahi mahā śaṅkhaṃvinādevivināmantrasiddhidāyikaḥ sākṣānabrahmamayīmālāmahāsakhākayāpunaḥ sāligrāmecavṛndāyāṃgaṅgāyāṃsurapūjite nai vaspṛśanmahāśaṃkhaṃsparśanakāṣṭhamadbhavet|oṃca ṇḍikā||oṃgaṃgākāraṇavārīcamadyaṃparamakāraṇaṃ kāraṇasparśamātreṇamālātuṣṭibhavedyadi gaṃgāspa rśanamātreṇakāṣṭhavatmalikābhavet vadameparameśā nicetimesaṃśayohṛdi|| oṃśrīśaṃkaraḥ||oṃkāraṇe
<śrīḥ 5a> nivaseddevimahākālīparākalā mahāvidyotvaseddevi surayāṃsurapūjitā mahāśaṅkhevasennityaṃ paṃcāśabdarṇarū piṇī mahāśaṅkhevasennityaṃmahāvidyācasarvadā kāṣṭaspa rśenamātreṇamahāvahnismṛtaṃyathā gaṃgāsparśatathā devī gaṃgāyālīyatepriye tatkṣaṇenamahāśaṅkhaṃkā ṣṭavatnātrasaṃśayaḥ śilāyāṃcātulasyādau tathai vaparameśvarī mahāśaṅkhasyaśājñāyāṃyojapetsādhako dhamaḥ aṣṭasiddhiḥkaretasyasevaśambhuravyayam maulegaṃgāsthiteryasyagaṃgāsthānenatasyakim vārāṇasīkāmahayaṃharidvāraprayāgakam gaṇḍakībadarīdevī gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgamaḥ yasyabhaktimahāśaṅkhaṃ tasyadarśanamātrataḥ tirtha sthānaphalaṃsarvaṃlabhatenātrasaṃśayaḥ ititekathi taṃkāntesāraṃparamadurlabham navaktavyaṃpaśoragdheprā ṇaṃteparameśvari|| [oṃitiśrīmātṛkātantreca turthaḥpaṭalaḥ]||4|| oṃ śrīḥ
oṃśrīcaṇḍikā||oṃpāradaṃbhasmanirmāṇaṃkenopāyena śaṃkaraḥ tadahaṃśrotumicchāmiyaditestikṛpāmapi|oṃ śrīśaṃkarovāca||oṃpāradaṃbhasmanirmāṇaṃnānāvidyādi dhāriṇī atevahitantrādauśāntiṃkuryāddvijotumāṃ vardhayetkarmakartāraṃvakṣyamānaṃvidhānataḥ bhogaṃbhogyaṃpradā tavyaṃ madhuparkaṃsureśvari paṃcāmṛtenadeveśisnāpayecchu ddhavāriṇā puruṣasyayathāyogyaṃyugmaṃvasthunivedayet caturaṅgulavistāraṃraupyāditāmrapīṭhakaṃ alaṃkāraya thāyogyaṃpuruṣasya nivedayet alaktasaṃyutaṃvāpi puṣpaṃdadyājjalaṃśive ṣaḍaṅgaśruvadeveśipradadhyācca punaḥpunaḥ ghṛtayuktaṃtathādīpaṃdadhyātkalyāṇahela ve naivedyaṃvividhaṃramyaṃnānāphalasamanvitam śarkarā saṃyutaṃkṛtvāpāyasaṃcanivedayet dadhyāttoyamaheśā ni vijayāsaṃyutaṃpriye ṣaḍakṣaraṃmahāmantraṃgajānta kasahasrakaṃ prajapetsādhakaḥśreṣṭhaḥtatsiddhirabhavaddhuvaṃ athavāparameśānidhanadādhanadāyinī pūjayedbahu yatnāniṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥ dvādaśāhaṃjapeddhī mandivasahasraṃtatojapet taddaśāṃśaṃmaheśāni
<śrīḥ 6a> homaṃkuryādvicakṣaṇā homakarmādaśaktaccedviguṇajapamāca ret yadiprītāmevatsāhitadākiṃkinalabhyate pra tyahaṃparameśānikuberādipatevasu bhasmanirmāṇakaṃ devī vicinyaṃtasyakiṃśive guravedakṣiṇāṃdatvā yathāvibhavavistaram tataḥsiddhābhavetmantrīnātrakā ryāvicāraṇā||caṇḍikovāca|| vidhānaṃdevadeve śibhasmanirmāṇakarmaṇi satkṛtaṃyenarūpenabhasma sājāyatevibhiḥ||oṃśrīśaṃkaruvāca||oṃānīya pāradaṃsthāpayetprapaśyadyadiroparī tasyoparijapenma ntraṃ śarvalakṣaṇacātmakaṃ ṣaṭsahasraṃhideveśipraja petsādhakāguṇaiḥ svayaṃmbhūpuṣpasaṃyukte vasthecāru ṇasannibhe saṃsthāpyapāradaiḥdevī mṛtpātrayuga leśive puṣpayuktenasūtreṇabandhvīyādabhayaṃtataḥ mṛtikāpaṃcahyobhiścadhānyasyaparameśvari lepa yedbahuyatnena raudraśuṣkaṃcakārayet punaścale payeddhīmāntatovahnau vinikṣipet aṣṭamīna vamīrātrau kṣipennaivakadācana|| oṃśrīśaṃjñikā(?)
oṃsvayambhūkīdṛśaṃnāthakuṇḍagolaṃcakīdṛśaṃ svapuṣpaṃ kīdṛśaṃnāthavajrapuṣpaṃcakīdṛśaṃ sarvakālodbhavaṃnā thakīdṛśaṃvadaśaṅkara||oṃśrīśaṃkaraḥ|| vivāharahi tākanyāprathamārthatusaṃyutāḥ tacchroṇitaṃmaheśāni svayambhūnātrasaṃśayaḥ vidyamānebhatteridhākanyāvai cānyagāśive tadudbhavaṃkuṇḍapuṣpaṃsarvakāryārthasā dhakaṃ mṛtaṃbhatterideveśiyāvalācānyagāśive tadu dbhavaṃgolapuṣpaṃdevavaśyakaraṃparaṃ vivāharahitākanyā prathamekratusaṃbhavet tacchroṇitaṃmaheśānisvapuṣpasarva mohanaṃ vivāhitāyākanyāyāpuruṣasyatāḍanāt ya dipuṣpaṃsamudbhūtaṃvajraṃtatparikīrtitam vivāhitā yākanyāyā pratimāsaṃcayadbhavet sarvakālodbha vaṃpuṣpaṃ kathitaṃvīravandite saptarātrauvahnirmadhyesthāpa yedbahuyatnataḥ tatutthāpyataddravyaṃsvarṇapātrenidhāya ca prajapetparameśāniprasādākhyaṃmahāmanuḥtataḥ siddhobhavenmantrīnānyathāmamabhāṣitaṃ enaṃmantraṃmaheśā nigajāntakasahasrakaṃ japitvāpūjayetpaścātpārthi vaṃśivaliṃgakaṃ tataḥparīkṣākartavyā śṛṇumatprāṇa vallabhe śuddhatāmraṃvahnimadhyemṛtvāṃtretolakadvayam
<śrīḥ 7a> dravyebhūtecatāmrecaguñjāmānaṃkṣipedyadi tatkṣaṇepara meśānisvarṇaṃbhavatiniñcitaṃ guñjāmānaṃtutaddravyaṃbhoja naṃkuruteyadi sarvarogaiparityaktojāyatemadanopamaḥ mantrasiddhirbhavettasyajāyatecirajīvinaḥ pratyahaṃparame śāniśatanārīramedyadi vīryādirahitotasyāḥtejo vṛddhikaraṃparaṃ maraṇānaivapaśyāmiyadidhyānayutobhavet tasyavittaṃvilokaivakuberopitiraskṛtaḥ jānecatusva raṃsākṣāndānetuvāsavoyathā maheśevayogīndromṛte hitusudurdharaḥ mahāvaktromahāvīryomahāśāhaśikāśu ciḥ mahāvakṣodayānāṃcasarvaprāṇihiteṣuca bahu kiṃkathyatedevisamyakpānanāyakaḥ|| [itiśrīmātṛ kābhedetantrepaṃcamaḥpaṭalaḥ]||5||oṃdevyuvāca|| oṃvadamīśānasarvajñasarvatantravidāṃvara mahāroge mahāduḥkhemahādāridrasaṅkaṭe nānāpīḍigatenā thanānāpīḍādisaṅkaṭe rājanāśerājabhayekārā gāranṛgatepunaḥ rājñodaṇḍecadeveśisatathāgraha pīḍine kairupāyaidrutaṃnāthamucyatevadameprabhoḥ|| oṃśivuvāca||oṃśṛṇucārvaṅgiśubhageyanmātvaṃ paripṛcchasi tattesarvaṃpravikṣyāmisāvadhānāvadhāraya
yācādyāparamāvidyācāmuṇḍākālikāparā tasyaprayo gamātreṇakiṃn siddhyatibhūtale||śrīdevyuvāca||oṃrā huccaṇḍālamākhyātaḥsarvatraparameśvara puṇyakālaṃkathaṃ deva stenamṛṣṭedivākare niśākaretathānāthaceti mesaṃśayohṛdi kathayasvaparānandapaścādanyatraprakāśa ya||oṃśrīśivovāca||oṃśṛṇucārvaṅgiśubhage grahāṇāṃcottamottamaṃ grahāṇāṃtrividhaṃdevicandrasūryā gnirūpiṇaṃ śaktirlalāṭenetrecavahnistavatisarvathā vāmanetrestathācandrodakṣestarpyaprataṣṭhati sambhūnāthenadeve śiramaṇaṃkriyateyadā tadaivagrahaṇaṃdevīśaktiyuktesa dāśive vāmanetrecumbaṃnecacarṇaṃkiṃgrahaṇaṃtadā lalā ṭecumbatecāgnigrahaṇaṃparameśvari śivobījayate vahniatodṛśyasureśvarī śivaśaktisamāyogokālo brahmamayaḥśive atevamaheśānirāśyādinnavi cārayet rāśyādigaṇanaṃcaivayavanaśrutisundarī ti thinakṣatrayogocayoyogaḥparameśvari tatraivaparameśā nirāśyādigaṇanaṃcaret śivaśaktisamāyogaḥsa rvabrahmamayaṃjagat māsapakṣatithīnāṃcanocāraḥ parameśvari dṛṣṭimātreṇajantavyaṃtadasiddhobhaveddhruvam
<śrīḥ 8a> tatkālaparamākālīvijñeyovīravandite tatrapadyatkṛtaṃkarma tadantaraphalaṃlabhet navaktavyaṃpaśoragreprāṇātepisure śvari etatatvaṃprayatnenabrahmajānātisādhakaḥ pragopta vyaṃprayatnena svayonirivapārvati||śrīdevyuvāca||cāmu ṇḍāyāḥmahāmantraṃkīdṛśaṃparameśvara ārādhanaṃkī dṛśaṃvā tadvadasvadayānidhe||oṃśrīśivuvāca|| śṛṇucārvaṅgisubhagecāmuṇḍāmantramuttamam ya syavijñānamātreṇapunajanmanavidyate kālībīja yugaṃdevikūrmabījatataḥparam tryakṣarīparamāvī dmācāmuṇḍākālikāsvayaṃ cetasāpūjayeddevīśu ddhāccāraiḥcaṣoḍaśaiḥ pūjāntepūjayenmantraṃtrisaha sraṃvarānane rātrautupūjayeddevipaṃcattatvenasādha kaḥ tathārātraujapenmantraṃkulaśaktisamanvitam ya ntranirmāṇayogyaṃhipīṭhaṃdadyātsuvistaram bhogabhogyaṃ pradātavyaṃmadhuparkaṃyathocitam śakteyathāvidhe yasmādhyuvatyā parameśvari tathāvastaṃpradātavyaṃ sarva kalyāṇahetave alaṅkāratathādevī tatratatrani yojayet naivedyaṃvividhaṃramyaṃnānādravyasamanvitam yāmeṣātraṃpradātavyaṃ paramānnaṃsaśarkaram pūjayetpa rayābhaktyā balīdānaṃtataḥparaṃ
pratyahaṃparameśānicādyaṃtevābaliṃharet evaṃkṛtemahā siddhiṃ labhyatenātrasaṃśayaḥ dhanārthidhanamāpnotiputrārthi putravānbhavet vivādejayamāpnotirājadvārejayī bhavet sarvatravijayībhūtvādevīputrivapsitau rogebhyo ghorarūpebhyaḥ pūjayitvāpramucyate ikṣāsiddhirbhavettasya sarvasiddhinacānyathā kārāgāragatovāpimucyatenā trasaṃśayaḥ prayogaṃparameśānisāraṃparamadurlabham atisnehenadeveśitavakhyāneprakāśitam athavāpara meśānipaṭheccaṇḍīsureśvari pūjayeccaṇḍikāṃdevīṃsu gandhipuṣpasaṃyute dhūpadīpenagandhenanevedyenasure śvari avaśyaṃpaṃcatatvenapūjayeccaṇḍikāṃparāṃ ādyā ddravyādisnehenacarpyāteparameśvari paṃcatatvaṃsamānīyaso dhayenmantravittataḥ tarpaṇaṃcatathākṛtvācārghapātrevi nikṣipet arghodakenasaṃprokṣyapūjayetpīṭhasaṃvatam praṇavaṃcasamuddhṛtyamāyābījaṃtataḥparam prabhāmā yāṃjapāṃsūkṣmāṃviśuddhānandanītathā suprabhāṃvi jayāṃsarvasiddhidāparipūjayet śaṃṣaṃnīddhiṃpadma nīddhiṃtathābrahmādikājapet ṣaḍaṅgenataṃsampūjya parivānprapūjayet
<śrīḥ 9a> indrādīnāṃcatathāvajrādiścaprapūjayet praṇavādi namontenapūjayetsādhakottamaḥ punardevīmaheśāni paṃcatatvenapūjayet prāṇāyāmaṃtataḥkṛtvākāraṇādī nsamācaret tasyaidevyāsvayaṃpītvāpaṭheccaṇḍīsureśvarī sāṅgepātetumahātamyepunaḥprāṇaṃsamāharet tata stupūjayedvimānakrameṇapānamācaret samāptena vilomenamūlamantraśataṃjapet yadibhāgyavaside vībhaktiyogaṃlabhennaraḥ tataḥkṣaṇekṣaṇibījāni sarvasiddhiḥkaresthitā evaṃkṛtvāmaheśāniyadipā ṭhaṃsamācaret māhātmyaṃtasyapāṭhasyakiṃvaktuṃśakyate mayā sakṛtpāṭhenadeveśikiṃpunaḥbrahmakevalaṃ a vaśyaṃlabhateśāntisarvatraparameśvari yadiśāntino labhyetamamavākyamṛṣātadā ṣoḍaśānopacāreṇa prathamaṃpūjanaṃcaret dvitīyaṃpaṃcatatvenapūjayetca ṇḍikāṃpriye sahasrāmatipāṭhenayatphalaṃlabhyate naraḥ sakṛtpāṭhenadeveśikalānārhatiṣoḍaśīṃ dhyānamasyāpravikṣyāmiyathādhyātvāpaṭhetnaraḥ||oṃ
khaṃpātuhrīṃjihvāṃparirakṣatuśrīṃbījaṃsandhidevāsehasa khaphreṃbhujadvayaṃ hakāraṃkaṇṭhadeśaṃmeśakāraṃṣoḍaśadalaṃ kṣakāraṃtadadhaṃpātumakāraṃhṛdayaṃmama lakāraṃpṛṣṭhadeśaṃme varaupārśvesadevatān puṃkārovāmapārśvetuśakarometurova tu heṃkārodakṣiṇabhujaṃkṣakārovāmahastakam makāraṃsvā ṅgulīpātulakaromebhujānan vakāromamabālaṃcarakā rojaṭharaṃtathā yoṃkārapādayugalaṃklīṃtusarvāṅgaṃmevatu hauṃhauṃliṅgaṃsarvāṇikeśaṃcayarakṣatu eṃbījaṃpātupūrvaṃ cahrīṃbījaṃdakṣiṇevṛttaśrīṃbījaṃpaścimepātuture dbhutasañcaraḥ śrīpātucāgrekoṇetutadaivanainṛtervatu devyaṃvāpātuvāyavyeīśānyāṃpātupādukāṃ pūjayāmi tathācordhvaṃnamaścārdhesadāvatu ititekathitaṃkāntekavacaṃ paramādbhutam gurumantraṃjapitvātukavacaṃyaḥpaṭhedya di sasiddhaḥsagaṇaḥsopiśivasākṣānnasaṃśayaḥ pūjākālepaṭhedyastukavacaṃmantravigrahaṃ pūjāphalaṃbhavettasya satyaṃsatyaṃsureśvari trisandhyaṃprapaṭheddevisasiddhonātrasaṃśayaḥ bhūrjevilakhedvidhivasvarṇasthaṃdhārayedyadi tasyadarśanamātreṇa
<śrīḥ 12a> vādināniprabhāmatā vivādejayamāpnotiraṇecavijayī bhavet sabhāyāṃjayamāpnotimamatulyonasaṃśayaḥ sahasrāre bhāvayantaṃtrisandhyaṃprapaṭhedyadi sevasiddholokeṣunirvāṇapada mīyate samastamaṃgalaṃnāmakavacaṃparamādbhutam yasmaikasmai nadātavyaṃnaprakāśaṃkadācana deyaṃśiṣyāyaśāntāyacānyathā patitaṃbhavet bhakteyastudeveśiputrebhyopinadīyate idaṃka vacamajñātvā(a)daśavidyāṃcayojapet samāptotiphalaṃtasya cāntecanarakaṃvrajet samāptaṃkavacaṃdevikimanyedhotumi cchati tavasnehānarodhenakiṃmayānaprakāśitam kūrma bījaṃsamuccāryaprāśamantraṃtatapriye anenavāyuyoge nakuṇḍalīcakramāṃcaret aṣṭottaraśataṃmūlamantraṃjaptāṃ nmetsudhī pānakarmatataḥkṛtvāsandhyāṃkuryātpūrṇeditā||śrī devī||sandhyāyāṃkīdṛśaṃdhyānavadameparameśvara||śrīvidyāviṣamenāthaviśeṣomapikathyatāṃ||oṃ śrīśivovāca||dhyāyeccasundarīṃdevīṃtribhedaṃbījarūpi ṇīṃ dhyāyeccavaiṣṇavīṃdevīṃśuklavarṇasvarūpiṇīṃ kāmabī jaṃsvarūpaṃcanīlavarṇaṃvicintayet śaktibījaṃsvarṇa varṇaṃraktavarṇaṃvibhāvayet prabhāteśuklavarṇāṃcamadhyāhnenī
nīlasannibhāṃ sāyāhneraktavarṇāṃbhāṃbhāvayetsādhakottamaḥ evaṃdhyātvāmaheśānisandhyāṃkuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ śivapūjā tataḥkṛtvāpūjayetparadevatā tripurāparamāvidyāma hāvidyāpativratā patipūjā vināpūjānagṛhṇa ntikadācana atevamaheśānicādauliṃ gaṃprapūjayet paṃcākṣaraṃpaṃcavaktraṃpūja yedbahuyatnataḥ tatastupūjayeddevīṃ tripurāmokṣadāyinī||śrīdevī|| kimādhārayecchumbhaṃkṛpayāvada vadaśaṃkara ādhārabhedadeveśisādhakaḥphalabhā kbhavet||oṃśrīśaṃkaraḥ||oṃpūjayetpārthivaṃ liṃgaṃpāṣāṇeliṃgaketathā svarṇaliṃgaṃtathādevī taupyevātāmrakāśyape pāradevāthagaṃgāyāṃsphaṭike markannathavā asyabhedenadeveśibhasmanirmitaliṅgake bālukānirmiteliṃgegomayeccāthapūjayet saskāraṃca pravikṣyāmiparameśivayadbhavet raupyaṃcasvarṇaliṃgaṃca
